answer: Because the timing is recorded against the river challenge, the ledge audit can replay the thread history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 285 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. A farm of 4191 identities would post 3328 proofs and burn roughly 41 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
